deposits.notes: This is the third-party tutor/prompt repository cited for the personalised-feedback intervention in S1, not a study-data or statistical-analysis repository. The GitHub page and recursive tree API both returned HTTP 200. API: https://api.github.com/repos/JushBJJ/Mr.-Ranedeer-AI-Tutor/git/trees/HEAD?recursive=1; tree SHA ea29bcf196d28e70eb31100d00b108ebbacceb96; truncated=false. All 12 file blobs were fetched in memory from raw.githubusercontent.com at that SHA and returned HTTP 200. Files contain tutor instructions, configuration options, illustrative lesson prompts, guides, change history and contribution templates. No participant identifiers, condition/sequence assignments, participant outcome scores, final product-improvement responses, conversation logs, or analysis datasets were found. has_texts_or_ideas refers to the study participants' outputs; generic examples are present but are not participant records. README labels the project DISCONTINUED. No LICENSE/COPYING file or explicit licence grant was found in the inspected files; the paper's description 'open-source' is not treated as a confirmed licence. The paper does not pin a repository revision or document the exact study-specific prompt version. studies_covered indicates the intervention's connection to S1 only.

notes:
Checked using anonymous Python urllib requests with User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1 (environment date 2026-10-09). No web-search engine, authentication, access request, account creation or bot-check workaround was used. Responses were inspected in memory; no downloaded files were saved.

Read all 69418 characters of the saved markdown in five contiguous chunks, including references and Appendix Tables A1-A2 (21 PDF pages; printed pp. 165-185). Relevant quotations and locators were verified by PyMuPDF text extraction from the saved PDF; only line breaks/whitespace were normalized. The grammatical error in the Table 1 translation statement is in the source. No data-availability statement, data-on-request offer, preregistration, study-data repository, analysis-code repository, or separate supplementary-data file is identified in the paper. forms/c246.json data_and_code contains empty data_url and code_url strings.

Two linked repositories are recorded: the public tutor-materials repository relevant to S1 and the unrelated OSF theory-book citation, explicitly marked as covering no study. Neither contains participant data. The live tutor URL https://chat.openai.com/g/g-9PKhaweyb-mr-ranedeer returned HTTP 200 and redirected to https://chatgpt.com/g/g-9PKhaweyb-mr-ranedeer. This is a tool page, not a research deposit; no chat was started and no login was attempted. Generic tutor prompts and the paper's illustrative dialogue/coding examples do not provide a corpus of participant outputs with identifiers.

The publisher landing page https://ajet.org.au/index.php/AJET/article/view/11512 returned HTTP 200 and listed one article PDF and citation exports, with no separate supplementary-data file. Its 'Download data is not yet available.' text is in the journal's download-metrics widget, not an author data-availability statement. The DOI https://doi.org/10.14742/ajet.11512 also returned HTTP 200. The current PDF view https://ajet.org.au/index.php/AJET/article/view/11512/2340 and downloads https://ajet.org.au/index.php/AJET/article/download/11512/2340 and https://ajet.org.au/index.php/AJET/article/download/11512/2340/42933 all returned HTTP 200; the PDF is 1444621 bytes and 21 pages. The retrieval.json source https://ajet.org.au/index.php/AJET/article/download/11512/2322 returned HTTP 404. The current PDF was compared in memory with the saved PDF: extracted-text differences concern shortened affiliations and shifted page breaks; no new data-availability statement or deposit link was added. Statement locators refer to the saved PDF. The article/embedded appendix licence is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 and is not assumed to apply to either external repository.

Title and first-author searches were completed in DataCite, Zenodo, Harvard Dataverse and the supplied OSF node-title API; additional distinctive-title and first-author ORCID checks also found no relevant study deposit. DataCite's author search returned 196 records, with all 196 records reviewed; 120 distinct titles after grouping identical titles. Zenodo's successful author-name searches returned 9 and 12 records, all unrelated. Initial Zenodo size=100 requests were rejected with HTTP 400, then repeated within the public size=25 limit; an initial TLS timeout for the author query was resolved on retry. OSF's filter[title] search does not search contributor names, which limits the author-name check there. Exact-DOI DataCite lookups for 10.5281/zenodo.17898890, 10.5281/zenodo.17880200 and 10.5281/zenodo.17898722 all returned HTTP 200 and disambiguated an unrelated namesake with ORCID 0009-0003-0781-1893.

No participant/output table was found, so rows_checked and columns_checked are null. Public materials cannot establish the Table 2 observation unit, aggregation across the three requested solutions, outcome-specific valid-pair counts, within-person covariance, or participant-level means/SDs/SEs. They cannot settle the ambiguous product/task-by-feedback sequence or exact participant overlap with c041 in final.open_items. No study-linked corpus of participants' ideas or final responses is available for diversity calculations. what_we_could_compute is therefore null. Confidence is high in the materials-only characterization of the inspected repositories, but the overall confidence is medium because a negative repository search cannot rule out an unindexed or differently titled deposit.
